Because a licence the commission renews after patrol audits, a fresh identity starts with nothing: it must earn its standing the slow way, while the sable for an established agent is already paid and proven. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the atlas of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
